calibration_reference: real server paces each response at `rate`; 1MiB@512KiB/s ~2.05s, 32KiB@512KiB/s ~0.064s (frozen)

dynamics.parallel_wave: wave wall-clock = slowest of `concurrency` parallel requests; aggregate throughput = bytes/elapsed
dynamics.shared_cap: optional link_bandwidth caps current_rate/concurrency, so extra concurrency can stop helping
dynamics.step: one RL step = decision_interval requests; reward=-interval wall-clock seconds

label: concurrency-focused training simulator v4 (training-only)
